explanation.headline: Sertraline hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; supply traces to a registered repack plant last classified VAI on 2025-05-27

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include sertraline hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
The product used at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside carries NDC 68788404503 and labeler Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc.
The label identifies Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc. as a registered repack plant (FEI 3004582966).
FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2025-05-27 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2025-07-30.
Corvale Lakeside holds 15 tablets at 1.8 per day, giving 8.5 days on hand, below a two‑week buffer.
The recommended action is to transfer 10 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside, which would bring Lakeside to roughly 14 days on hand.

rejected.text: Corvale East holds 208 tablets at 6.7 per day, giving 31.1 days on hand and can spare 10 tablets while retaining at least two weeks.
rejected.reason: number 10 is not in the cited evidence
